subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the focused fresh-session fallback while accepted disconnects may still run both gateway and embedded turns, or should it wait for the reattach-first design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The patch is a narrow bug fix with proof, but it intentionally preserves recook-first behavior for accepted disconnects, which affects session state and possible message delivery side effects.

options.title: Land focused isolation now
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style recook boundary for this rare disconnect path and review the reattach-first redesign separately.

options.title: Wait for reattach-first
options.body: Pause this PR if duplicate model/tool execution or possible duplicate delivery is unacceptable even on an isolated fallback session.

options.title: Split by delivery mode
options.body: Ask for a narrower design that preserves recook-first for interactive stdout but uses reattach-first for `--deliver` paths.

recommendation.title: Land focused isolation now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style recook boundary for this rare disconnect path and review the reattach-first redesign separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about CLI gateway fallback behavior, and recent file history shows the strongest CLI-side routing signal there.
